python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('classic/vendor/earshot')
files=['classic/.gitignore','classic/scripts/prepare-earshot-runtime.mjs','classic/scripts/test-earshot-runtime.mjs']
files += [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('classic/apps/web/src/earshot').glob('*') if p.is_file()]
files += [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('classic/apps/web/public/earshot').glob('*') if p.is_file()]
files += [str(p) for p in root.glob('*') if p.is_file()]
files += [str(root/'upstream'/r['path']) for r in json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text())]
subprocess.run(['git','add','--sparse','-f','--',*files],check=True)
pathlib.Path('/tmp/earshot-own-paths.json').write_text(json.dumps(files))
print('staged own paths',len(files))
subprocess.run(['git','commit','--only','-m','feat: vendor Earshot and synthesize all sounds in isolated WASM','--',*files],check=True)
PY
